content: (1) Swap: swapping two adjacent internal characters of a word. (2) Drop: removing an internal character of a word. (3) Keyboard: substituting an internal character with adjacent characters of QWERTY keyboard (4) Add: inserting a new character internally in a word. In line with the psycholinguistic studies BIBREF5 , BIBREF4 , to ensure that the perturbations do not affect human ability to comprehend the sentence, we only allow the adversary to edit the internal characters of a word, and not edit stopwords or words shorter than 4 characters.
